item.title: The case for Rose in Street Fighter 6 goes through K-Pop Demon Hunters and following up on a key storyline from prior game
item.description: <p>Rose from the Street Fighter 5 character select screen is featured on both sides of the image of this story, the middle is Rumi from Netflix's K-Pop Demon Hunters. K-Pop Demon Hunters has over 236 million views and is the most watched film on Netflix, the world's biggest streaming company.</p> <p>You can see that the two bear a striking resemblance to one another, Rose and Rumi, with their hair color, similar face and eye shape, and noses and mouths.</p>
